Keonjhar District Court Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Keonjhar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to attend the walk-in interview is 14th August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well before the scheduled time to complete the registration process.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Bench Clerk (Grade-I) post?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria for the Bench Clerk (Grade-I) post is that the candidate must be a Retired Ministerial Staff with a clean service record. This is a specific requirement for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Keonjhar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for various posts, including Bench Clerk (Grade-I), Senior Stenographer, Senior Clerk, Junior Typist, and Peon.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the posts advertised by Keonjhar District Court?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 70 years. There is no minimum age limit specified for retired personnel.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the Keonjhar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category of candidates applying for the Keonjhar District Court Recruitment 2026. Both General/OBC and SC/ST candidates are exempt from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the posts advertised by Keonjhar District Court will be based on a Walk-In Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates. One set of self-attested photocopies of these documents is also required.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is contractual. This means the selected candidates will be appointed on a contract basis for a specified period.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held at the Keonjhar District Court premises in Keonjhar, Odisha. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Can freshers apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, freshers cannot apply for this recruitment. The eligibility criteria specifically state that candidates must be Retired Ministerial Staff with a clean service record.
